description: This file defines the Promotion controller class within the OpenCart installation process, responsible for making an HTTP request to fetch promotional or installation data from the OpenCart website.

classes.name: Promotion
classes.description: A controller class in the install namespace that handles fetching promotion data via an external API call.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the OpenCart API endpoint to retrieve promotional data, returning the response or an empty string if the request fails.
